name: Awesome Tridents
description:
原版的三叉戟简直就是设计成功的武器的反面教材。逆天的获取难度，可爱的伤害，局限性极强的附魔……甚至还会因为手抖丢进虚空永远离你而去。"为什么不让它有用点呢？"你想道。于是你下载了本模组。希望它可以满足你对三叉戟的所有幻想！
The vanilla Trident is a textbook example of how *not* to design a weapon. It’s absurdly difficult to obtain, deals pathetic damage, and is severely limited in terms of enchantments - not to mention the risk of accidentally throwing it into the void, where it’s lost forever. "Why can't it actually be useful?" you wonder. So, you downloaded this mod - hoping it will finally fulfill all your dreams for what a Trident should be!
